text:
sara-partners: Heads-up — CloudMart marketplace listing (joint with NebulaEdge + DataGrid SI). Need to lock asset owners, staging slot, and an embargo window. Quick sync?

dylan-marketing: +1 from me. Proposed embargo: May 14 14:00 PDT. Marketing needs final assets 48h before handoff.

kevin-ops: We need a 2hr staging cutover for infra smoke tests (DB migration + ingress sanity). Can we target May 10 02:00-04:00 UTC?

lucas-eng: Which NebulaEdge SKU are we validating? Also size of model bundle so we can estimate GPU needs.

sara-partners: NebulaEdge v2 rack; SI will onboard DataGrid v1. Assets to deliver: press release (PR), long-form blog, landing hero + screenshots, 2 demo vids (1x product, 1x SI integration), 1-pager. Tentative owner picks: @dylan-marketing PR+blog+press coord, @michelle-cs demos + docs, @kevin-ops staging + cutover, @lucas-eng perf + model validation.

anika-legal: Need partner logo files, trademark/crediting rules, and any partner quote approvals. Please upload to Legal folder (GDrive link) by EOD Fri so I can review.

ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled maintenance created: staging-reserve-1799 — May 10 02:00-04:00 UTC (locked). Link: https://infra.redwood/staging/1799

dylan-marketing: I'll own the PR and agency sync. Action: finalize PR draft by Tue 10:00 PT. Also want a one-line partner quote from NebulaEdge by Mon COB.

michelle-cs: Demos — we need two sandbox tenants and sample datasets from DataGrid. @sara-partners can you confirm SI will provide? Also need 2 short scripts: happy path and perf smoke.

lucas-eng: For perf: we'll validate with quantized model, seq=1024, batch sizes [1,4,8]. Rough baseline: ~200 rps using 4xA100-equivalent. I'll run a preflight next Wed and report metrics.

kevin-ops: Reserving staging slot now (ops-bot did it). I can also request tenant provisioning — need exact tenant IDs by May 6.

dylan-marketing: Question — do we have a hard embargo exception process? If NebulaEdge needs to go earlier, what's the route?

anika-legal: Embargo exceptions must go through Legal + Partnerships + PR. I'll sign off only after logos/quotes are cleared. If partner requests earlier, escalate to me + @sara-partners with written reason.

sara-partners: Cool — next steps summary:
```
- By May 6: SI provides sample data + tenant IDs (DataGrid)
- By May 8 EOD: Asset pack in Legal folder (logos, PR quote, screenshots) — owner: dylan-marketing
- May 10 02:00-04:00 UTC: Staging cutover & infra smoke — owner: kevin-ops
- May 11: Engineering perf preflight results — owner: lucas-eng
- By May 12 noon PT: Legal sign-off on assets — owner: anika-legal
- May 14 14:00 PDT: Embargo lift / publish (press + blog + landing) — owner: dylan-marketing
- Post-launch: CS demos + churn play — owner: michelle-cs
```

kevin-ops: I'll confirm tenant provisioning ETA by EOD Tue. Linking runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/marketplace-cutover
dylan-marketing: I'll schedule a 15min preflight check Fri at 9am PT to run through final readiness checklist.

sara-partners: Sounds good. If anyone sees gaps ping me here. Can we do the 15min pulse on Fri?

anika-legal: Friday 9am PT works for Legal.

michelle-cs: Works for CS too. I'll bring demo checklists.

sara-partners: Thanks — closing loop.
